errors.explanation: Broken file links cause runtime errors when the skill tries to reference non-existent resources.
errors.howToFix: Verify that the referenced file exists at the specified path relative to the SKILL.md file. If the file was moved, update the link. If it was removed, delete the link.

errors.explanation: Anthropic forbids XML tags in skill frontmatter because it appears in Claude's system prompt. This rule extends that protection to the SKILL.md body as a defense-in-depth measure, since body content is also loaded into Claude's context when the skill is invoked.
errors.howToFix: Remove non-standard XML tags from the SKILL.md body, or move them inside a fenced code block if they are example content. Use markdown formatting instead of custom XML tags for structuring instructions.

warnings.explanation: A missing usage section leaves users and the AI model without clear invocation instructions.
warnings.howToFix: Add a section like `## Usage`, `## Instructions`, `## Quick Start`, `## Getting Started`, `## How to Use`, or `## Examples` to the body of your SKILL.md file. Include invocation examples, expected arguments, and any flags or options the skill supports.
